title: add-benchmark-lab-multi-variant-profiling-and-reporting-pipeline-v64
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: add multi-variant profiling runners and a reporting pipeline iteration (v64) to capture mixed-variant inference workloads and surface per-variant perf baselines. This PR introduces representative workload runners that exercise model variants (FP16, int8, q4_0) across variable sequence lengths and batch shapes, a profiling baseline harness, and a new reporting pipeline to aggregate run artifacts into the benchmark lab dashboard. Changes include runner orchestration, consolidated artifact schema, and CI steps to validate perf stability. Checklist: - [x] implement multi-variant runner orchestration - [x] add profiling baselines for cold/warm starts - [x] add reporting pipeline (GHA -> data upload) - [x] update docs and examples - [x] add CI/perf guard rails Backwards compatibility: runners are opt-in via config flags and do not change existing single-variant flows. Related: ENG-1987 (multi-variant profiling design), ENG-2050 (reporting pipeline enhancements).
